content.tagline: Four pudding mist ampoules in a 100 g format
content.descriptor: CHAEWUN is a Korean skincare brand of Twelve Global Inc. focused on Pudding Mist Ampoules
about: The CHAEWUN name is linked to the Korean verb “to fill”. The official brand story presents this as adding what skin needs and bringing a small moment of comfort to a daily routine.

The official shop lists four 100 g Pudding Mist Ampoules: Collagen PDRN, Cica Cabbage, Vitamin and Hyaluron. Formula, labelling, documents and market-specific claims are verified separately for each project.
